summary: __thiscall: computes a normalised progress ratio in [0,1] over a range read from a queue, using either a wrap mode (v9 - v7) or a clamp mode driven by a session-time global minus a per-object offset (obj+0xF84). Returns (Delegation(this) - v8) / v9, or 0.0 when the computed range is <= 0. Used for steering/animation interpolation by SteeringAckermannComputation.

operations.description: Dereference this to get the object pointer v2 = *this, and initialise the two range locals v7 = 0.0 and v9 = 0.0.
Call QueuePeek(v2, &v7, &v9) to read the range's lower (v7) and upper (v9) bounds from the queue embedded in the object.
Branch on the byte flag at obj+0xF81 (3969): non-zero selects clamp mode, zero selects wrap mode.
Clamp mode: v3 = dbl_8AFEA0 - float at obj+0xF84 (3972); v8 = max(v3, v7); then v4 = dbl_8AFEA0 - v8.
Wrap mode: v4 = v9 - v7 and v8 = v7, i.e. range width with lower bound kept as the offset base.
When the computed range v4 is <= 0.0, return 0.0 immediately.
Call Delegation(this) to obtain the value v5 that is placed relative to the range.
Return the normalised ratio (v5 - v8) / v9.
Called by SteeringAckermannComputation (0x004DB170) to feed its steering interpolation.
